intervention: Two fixed shared readers consume each complete immutable base and original saved candidate inside the identical original RGB mask. No refit, patch rewrite, camera replacement, retuning or new sampling policy.
repeat_policy: Two fresh reader-only subprocesses. The exact same original one-per-object DA3 predictions and eight patches are reused. This is not an independent end-to-end reconstruction repeat.
evaluation_policy: Require all 80 normal rows and every frozen point/patch receipt before first object truth access. Score common output per row, and all ten native added-curve arms separately. Empty base native curves say nothing about raw point quality. Preserve rejected, empty, error and ambiguous output.
qualification: Two synthetic development assemblies, not real capture or external assets. Fixed local-task readout, not semantic target identity or whole-object topology. No reader qualification or G1 promotion; preserve baseline, naive controls, failures, timing and storage.
